title: CSA STAR for AI Level 1
note: The AI Controls Matrix's 247 control identifiers, with short titles written by this project, mapped onto the control library through CSA's own mappings of the matrix to AIUC-1, ISO/IEC 42001, ISO/IEC 27001 and NIST AI RMF (CSA's ISO/IEC 27002 citations read as the ISO/IEC 27001 Annex A controls of the same number), control-level references first and management-system clauses only where none exist. CSA's text is not included: its licence permits only personal, non-commercial use without modification or redistribution, so read the matrix at the source. There is no certification at Level 1: an organization self-assesses and signs its own attestation. Filing the AI-CAIQ with CSA's STAR Registry is the organization's own act, taking the same positions. A control no mapping resolves to the library maps to none, so the organization states its position on it (or maps a control of its own).
